headline: The hall light is still on.
body: A stair holds one damp print, already going pale at the edges. Two rooms over a radio is on, too low to name. We leave the desk lamp off; the morning has started without asking.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: lid lifting, not blue yet, one seam of white

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: a bus idling, brake lights only
